commonErrors.why: You divided the horizontal difference by the vertical. The slope is the vertical over the horizontal, and the unit of your product is s/m, which is the reciprocal of the velocity.
You added the values instead of subtracting them. : 24/8 = 3. The slope is a difference upon a difference.
You calculated the vertical difference alone and did not divide it by the horizontal difference.
You divide the elongation by the force. The unit of your output is m/N, which is the reciprocal of the spring constant.
You misplaced the decimal point when dividing by 0.060.
You divided by 0.60 instead of 0.060, that is, with an error of a factor of ten in the elongation.
You wrote the same mile. The slope is 4π²/g, not g, so it remains a heart and a beat.
You wrote 4π² and did not divide it by the mile.
You multiplied the slope by 4π² instead of dividing. The quick scan : g is close to 9.8, so any result far from it requires reviewing the arrangement.
